title: MCP can generate images, with docs to prove it
summary:
A small but useful day: MCP learned to make images, its docs got clearer, and o3-mini gained a thinking dial.

MCP gained image generation support, and the documentation now includes a screenshot so people can see the setup before asking their agent to make pixels.

o3-mini now accepts a reasoning_effort parameter, giving builders a direct knob for how much thinking they want from the model.
